messages:
anya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands. Two ops-ish asks: 1) should we enable per-tenant adaptive batching for Dedicated customers to improve latency for small tenants without impacting large tenants? 2) how should we annotate traces so we can debug tenant-induced head-of-line blocking?

samir: High-level: per-tenant adaptive batching is promising but risky for shared pools. Recommend an opt-in per-tenant flag for Dedicated then evaluate. For traces, include tenant_hash and batch_decision in spans.

leo: Perf note: adaptive batching can reduce avg latency for small tenants by avoiding oversized batches, but it increases scheduler complexity. Suggested knobs: tenant_batch_limit and tenant_microbatch_window_ms. Start with tenant_batch_limit=4.

anya: Ops question: if we enable opt-in, any memory or scheduling overhead?

leo: Minor scheduling overhead (~2-4% CPU in router) and bookkeeping mem for tenant state (tiny). Bigger concern is fragmentation of GPU capacity if many tenants opt-in.

mila: Ops guardrails: if we enable opt-in, we should add a quota so a single tenant can't hog the pool by having many small requests. Also add alerts for fragmentation (node utilization variance).

diana: Telemetry: please add these span attributes: tenant_hash, batch_decision, microbatch_delay_ms, batch_size, pool_id. We'll also want a per-tenant microbatch_delay histogram to detect H-O-L.

samir: For rollout: 1) feature flag off by default, 2) opt-in for a few trusted Dedicated customers, 3) run 48h A/B comparing p50/p95 and tokens/sec. If degradation -> auto-disable.

anya: Nice. One more: how to simulate tenant mixes? Any short script or config?

leo: Simple sim: generate Poisson arrival mixes with a few heavy tenants and many light tenants; vary request_size distribution. I can drop a short script later. For quick test, use microbatch_window_ms=5, tenant_batch_limit=4, max_batch_size=8.

mila: Ops checklist addition: when opt-in is enabled, track per-tenant latency skew, node utilization variance, and KV hit ratio per-tenant. We'll need dashboards.

infra-bot: feature-flag created: ff/adaptive-batching-tenant -> off. Use /ff toggle to enable for target tenants.

anya: Great, thanks. I'll draft an opt-in plan and tag kernel + ops leads. If leo posts the sim script here, that'd be perfect. :handshake:
